question: What last_pool holds after a load.

struct_fields.name: last_pool
struct_fields.comment: **The pool as the daily supply pass left it when it came to this province** - after the province's own takes, before anything further in the day. A province further from the depot is offered no more than this, and since it is visited first, what it reads is yesterday's: goods move one province a day. A province nothing was asked of does not have it brought up to date. Not saved. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-supplypass.md, section 3. **A loaded game starts with it empty** (seen 2026-11-16, FINDINGS-liveread.md section 116): the first midnight after a load hands nothing on from one province to the next, so a network's far end gets its first delivery a night late.
struct_fields.evidence: The recording wr15 of a load of Ireland1941_07_16_07: the Narvik network's northern provinces (855 898 935 938 977 979 1018 1054) gain nothing over the first midnight and on the second receive what a non-empty start gives on the first; OpenHOI3 with an empty start matches every province of that network on both nights. Wrong if a loaded game is seen to carry supplies between provinces at its first midnight.
struct_fields.revises: comment - empty after a load, seen
